js: (function(){var d=window.__dbg,T=d.THREE;var bb=new T.Box3();d.bed.traverse(function(o){if(o.isMesh&&o.visible){var v=o.visible,p=o.parent;while(p&&v){if(!p.visible)v=false;p=p.parent;}if(v)bb.expandByObject(o);}});var vst=bb.getSize(new T.Vector3()),vc=bb.getCenter(new T.Vector3());function cnt(mesh){if(!mesh||!mesh.count)return null;var m=new T.Matrix4(),v=new T.Vector3(),inb=0,out=0;for(var i=0;i<mesh.count;i++){mesh.getMatrixAt(i,m);v.setFromMatrixPosition(m).applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld);if(v.x>=bb.min.x&&v.x<=bb.max.x&&v.z>=bb.min.z&&v.z<=bb.max.z)inb++;else out++;}return {in:inb,out:out};}return JSON.stringify({visibleBox:{min:[+bb.min.x.toFixed(3),+bb.min.y.toFixed(3),+bb.min.z.toFixed(3)],max:[+bb.max.x.toFixed(3),+bb.max.y.toFixed(3),+bb.max.z.toFixed(3)],size:[+vst.x.toFixed(3),+vst.y.toFixed(3),+vst.z.toFixed(3)],center:[+vc.x.toFixed(3),+vc.z.toFixed(3)]},daisyInBed:cnt(d.daisies),lavInBed:cnt(d.lavender),grassInBed:cnt(d.grass)});})()
